scientific_integrity: The proof reduces Behzadipour's exact subset-sum criterion to a binary construction when \(p<2^a\) and a complete modular obstruction when \(p>2^a\). The finite verifier independently replays the subset-sum decision on 549 parameter pairs and is explicitly not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the minimal odd-prime-exponent family \(2^a p^2\); no claim is made for \(2^a p^{2b}\) with \(b>1\) or for additional prime supports.
title: A sharp dyadic threshold for two-layered numbers \(2^a p^2\)
